messages.subject: Project Granite — COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
Edward, Fiona,

I'm pleased to confirm that the acquisition of Calder Vale Foods Limited completed this afternoon. The Share Purchase Agreement has been executed by all parties and is attached in its execution form. Funds have been remitted in accordance with the funds flow and the escrow is in place.

We will circulate the completion bible in the new year and deal with the post-completion items (SH01 filing, stamp duty, and the Northborough consent). Congratulations to everyone involved.

Best,

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
